literal: Like to the shining moon that has filled its diminished edge, is there a blemish on the face of the beloved woman?
translation: Is there a blemish on the face of my beloved, like the dark spot found on the bright full moon that has filled out its crescent shape?
modern: தேய்ந்த பகுதி நிறைந்து விளங்கும் முழு நிலவுக்கு இருப்பது போல, என் காதலியின் முகத்தில் ஏதேனும் களங்கம் இருக்கிறதா?
explanation: In this verse, the lover praises the flawless beauty of his beloved's face by comparing it to the moon. He notes that even the bright, fully formed moon has a visible dark spot or blemish on its surface. However, when he looks at his beloved's face, he asks rhetorically if there is any such blemish to be found. By highlighting this contrast, he exalts her beauty as something even more perfect and spotless than the full moon itself.
